name: ingestlabs
description: Ingest Labs MCP — analytics, tag management, and more (production / mcp.ingestlabs.com)

interface.longDescription: Ingest Labs is a Data & Analytics plugin for marketers and analysts. After you sign in with the same portal account used on console.ingestlabs.com, ChatGPT queries your live production Ingest Labs Insights: attributed revenue by channel, Meta and Google Ads spend and ROAS, GA4 traffic, sessionized events, and traffic quality. You can also look up Tag Manager providers, tags, and data elements after you confirm an organization and project. The plugin only reads data the signed-in user is allowed to see. It does not sell products, move money, or invent organization or project ids.
capabilities: Inspect Meta and Google Ads spend and ROAS
Look up Tag Manager providers and tags
defaultPrompt: Show last 7 days of attributed revenue by channel for my org.
Compare Meta vs Google Ads ROAS for the last 30 days.
List tags in my project and which ones recorded events yesterday.
